body.statement: The refreshed insulin construction \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm{grid}}\) has \(360\) joint states, Dobrushin coefficient at most \(1/2\) under both policies, one-step policy overlap \(L=10/3\), and the analytic stationary-overlap bound \(d_e(s)\le720d_b(s)\) for every state. An interval-certified evaluation of its finite transition matrices satisfies \(-0.0060<\Delta_{\mathrm{imm}}<-0.0058\), so immediate action weighting is biased despite finite latent stationary overlap.
body.justification: The finite construction translates the theorem's uniform message into the published glucose-policy setting without claiming the continuous simulator satisfies the class.
body.gap: HuWager2023, Section 5.2 and equation (53), studies PHIW in a continuous synthetic glucose simulator but does not impose or verify joint latent stationary overlap; this proposition adds an explicit refreshed discretization and a certifiable overlap-and-bias calculation.
body.consumer: It demonstrates why bounded latent dietary occupancy does not by itself license current-action weighting for an insulin threshold policy.
